title: Pointwise affine tensor pullback stalk coordinate
statement: For commutative rings A and A', a ring map phi:A to A', a cochain complex M of A-modules, a representative isomorphism e:Q(tilde M) to K, an invertible ordinary pullback counit on tilde M, a degree i and a prime p of A', suppose the derived pullback L of K has quasi-coherent cohomology. Write b for the canonical affine base-change cohomology isomorphism [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates] and t for the localized ordinary tensor cohomology to pullback stalk coordinate constructed from the tilde tensor-pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change] and tilde stalk localization [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-stalk-localization]. For every localized cohomology class y, the canonical derived cohomology stalk coordinate [lem-pc-affine-derived-cohomology-presentation] of the localization of b(y) equals the stalk of H^i of the derived pullback of e, applied to the stalk of H^i of the inverse counit applied to t(y). This is the unchanged pointwise counit-coordinate equation; no main coordinate theorem is assumed.

proof.text: Use the global-sections factorization to express the affine coordinate as the unit followed by global sections of the sheaf comparison, inverse derived counit and representative isomorphism. Apply the proved general tilde localization and stalk identity. The forward-map API of the localized sheaf isomorphism identifies its first factor; preservation of composition by homology and stalk gives the counit-coordinate equation. The main coordinate equation composes the counit map and representative by functoriality.

proof_origin.place: Adjunction triangle and localization naturality, followed by functoriality

theorem affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso_counit_coordinate
    (A A' : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φg' : A →+* A')
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hL : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A'))
      ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).obj K))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ K)
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) (i : ℤ)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A') :
    let L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A')) := ⟨_, hL⟩
    let b := affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso A A' φg' K M e hc i
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace)) i
    let s := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace p
    let z := fun y => s.map (H.map (inv ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))))
      (affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso A A' φg' M p i y)
    ∀ y, affineDerivedCohomologyStalkIso A' i p L
        (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl b.hom.hom y) =
      s.map (H.map ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).map e.hom))
        (z y)
